post.description:
Create a new tool.

### Allowed Auth Scopes

- tools:CreateTool

parameters.name: company

schema.description: The unique identifier of the tenant when a service token is used.

parameters.description: The unique identifier of the tenant when a service token is used.

description.description: Description of the tool, used by AI to understand the purpose of the tool.

name.description: Name of the tool variable, e.g.: 'myvar'

description.description: Original description from MCP tool schema (preserved)

schema.description: JSON Schema in case if type is schema

variables.description: List of tool variables, used to pass data to the tool

username.description: SMTP server username for authentication, e.g.: 'john.doe@gmail.com'

from.description: From email address associated with the SMTP server, e.g.: 'john.doe@gmail.com'

url.description: URL endpoint for the webhook, supports variables in path and query parameters using {{variable_name}}, e.g.: 'https://api.example.com/users/{{userId}}?filter={{filter}}&page={{page}}'

value.description: Header value, supports static, variable, or template syntax

headers.description: HTTP headers for the webhook request. For custom authentication headers (e.g., X-API-Key), add them here instead of using auth.customHeader

body.description: Request body for POST, PUT, or PATCH requests

token.description: Bearer token value, supports static, variable, or template syntax

timeout.description: Time before webhook execution is stopped

search.description: Search handler configuration. API key comes from AppConfig; query comes from tool input. Optionally refine results using Tavily include_domains and/or exclude_domains (see Tavily domain filtering).

includeDomains.description: When non-empty, only return results from these domains or hosts. Customers may enter plain hostnames (example.com) or full URLs (https://example.com/path) — URLs are normalized to hostnames before calling the search API.

excludeDomains.description: When non-empty, omit results from these domains or hosts. Same hostname rules as includeDomains. Can be combined with includeDomains per Tavily API.

userId.description: User email address for direct messages.

botName.description: Name of the system bot that will send the message.

from.description: Sender phone number in E.164 format (e.g., +1234567890). This is the phone number that will appear as the sender of the SMS. Supports template syntax with variables.

to.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format (e.g., +1234567890). Supports template syntax with variables.

message.description: SMS message text to send. Supports template syntax with variables. Maximum length depends on carrier limits (typically 160 characters for single SMS, 1600 for concatenated).

token.description: Bearer token value, supports static, variable, or template syntax

items.description: List of enabled MCP tool IDs

tools.description: List of tools enabled for this MCP server.

mcpToolId.description: ID of the Tool that represents the MCP server connection (the Tool with handler.mcp containing serverUrl and authorization)

mcpToolName.description: Name of the tool on the MCP server. This matches the tool name returned from DiscoverTools operation.
